status: DRAFT, pending owner approval (LD-12). Not approved. A small, conservative starting list; the owner and the Teachers department review and replace it.
rules: Whole words and whole phrases only, never part of a word. Matching ignores case, Arabic diacritics and tatweel, alef, ya and ta marbuta variants, and repeated letters, so list each word once in its plain form.

Never list a word that occurs in the Quran, in hadith or in ordinary religious or lesson vocabulary (for example: zina, a shadh hadith, the people of Lut, dog, donkey, pig, Hell). The false-positive guard test (apps/api/test/unit/content-filter/false-positive-guard.spec.ts) runs the list over the whole Quran and the lesson text and fails on any match.
Never list a common personal name, or a word that is a name in transliteration.
